proceedings.outcome: the request to be questioned again was rejected
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 29 October 2005 M.T.’s request was rejected by the investigator.

proceedings.outcome: it does not appear that M.T. received any response to his appeal
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 3 November 2005 M.T. appealed to the regional prosecutor’s office against the investigator’s refusal to question him again. It does not appear that M.T. received any response to his appeal.

proceedings.outcome: the request to confront M.T. was rejected
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 3 November 2005 the applicant asked to confront M.T. His request was rejected by the investigator

proceedings.outcome: the second request to have a confrontation with M.T. was rejected
proceedings.supporting_quote: A second request by the applicant to have a confrontation with M.T., dated 15 November 2005, was rejected by the investigator on 16 November 2005 on identical grounds.

proceedings.outcome: the applicant was convicted of aggravated murder and the illegal acquisition, possession and carrying of firearms, and sentenced to 17 years’ imprisonment
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 8 December 2006 the court of first instance convicted the applicant of aggravated murder and the illegal acquisition, possession and carrying of firearms, and sentenced him to 17 years’ imprisonment.
On 27 June 2007 the Tbilisi Court of Appeal upheld the applicant’s conviction.
parties: the Tbilisi Court of Appeal (deciding body)

proceedings.outcome: the appeal on points of law was declared inadmissible
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 20 February 2008 the Supreme Court declared an appeal on points of law lodged by the applicant inadmissible.

proceedings.outcome: M.T. was convicted of obstructing justice by giving false testimony
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 26 December 2006 and 23 January 2007 respectively they were convicted at first instance of obstructing justice by giving false testimony.
